blurb: At Tijon Miami, our perfume creation experience is more than just making a fragrance. It’s a fully immersive, hands-on journey where you become a perfumer for the day. Each guest gets to explore high-quality raw materials, learn professional blending techniques, and craft a truly one-of-a-kind signature scent. Unlike typical workshops, we combine education, creativity, and luxury, making it a memorable experience for individuals, groups, and special occasions.
